statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → α ≤ 1/2 → ∀ ρ : ℕ → ℝ,
    Filter.Tendsto ρ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
    ∃ S : Set ℕ, (∀ p ∈ S, Nat.Prime p) ∧
      (∀ q r : ℕ, 0 < q → r < q → Nat.Coprime r q →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
          let P := (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p % q = r)
          (((P.filter (fun p => p ∈ S)).card : ℝ) / (P.card : ℝ)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds α)) ∧
      ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ N ≥ T, (1/2 - α + ρ N) * (N : ℝ) ≤
        (((Finset.Ioc N (2*N)).filter (fun n =>
          Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p ∈ S, ∃ q ∈ S, p+q=n)).card : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 对任意 0<α≤1/2 和趋零速率 ρ(N)，构造素数子集 S，使它在每个固定既约剩余类内的相对密度极限恰为 α，且每个充分大的区间 (N,2N] 至少有 (1/2−α+ρ(N))N 个偶数不能表示为 S 中两个素数之和。S 可依赖 α、ρ。
plain_statement.en: For every 0<α≤1/2 and real sequence ρ(N) tending to zero, construct a prime subset S with relative density limit exactly α in every fixed reduced residue class. Every sufficiently large shell (N,2N] must contain at least (1/2−α+ρ(N))N even integers outside S+S. The set may depend on α and ρ.

brief.zh: 待证。Alsetri–Shao 备注 1.3 给出局部下密度低于 1/2 的漏点构造。用素数无理旋转的等分布，把相位窗口的端点缓慢移向极限；用固定窗口夹逼各类密度，再按 ρ 对角选宽。α=1/2 时可据此检验仅凭真实局部密度可支持怎样的例外界。全站受信模块见 https://www.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json 。
brief.en: Open. Remark 1.3 of Alsetri–Shao constructs missed sums below local half-density. Use equidistribution of an irrational rotation on primes to approach a limiting window slowly. Sandwich the local densities between fixed windows, then select the widths using the given tolerance sequence. At α=1/2 this tests what rate of decay exact local densities can support. Verified modules are indexed at https://www.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json.
